name: Codex session
responsibility: Owns one initialized protocol session and its reviewed operations
description: The session performs the handshake and owns request identity serialization, response adoption, reverse requests, and failure classification. Coordinator and workhorse callers share this same implementation boundary. TASK-653.11: callers open it with openCodexSession on a Codex connection and get { session, control }; createCodexSession and codexSessionControl leave the interface, and a mutation failure is read as kind mutation through readCodexFailure.
